summary.text: Austin Magee describes himself as a blue-collar small business owner and builder with no previous political experience. He is running as a Republican on political reform, fiscal responsibility and oversight of artificial intelligence.

paragraphs.text: Magee describes himself as a blue-collar small business owner, builder and fixer.
The Louisiana Illuminator's voter guide lists him as a Republican from Franklinton and says he owns a family industrial contracting company.
He has no previous political experience and says he wants to prove an ordinary person can do the job.
His campaign calls for banning congressional stock trading, a term-limits amendment, limits on lobbying and greater financial disclosure by politicians.
